local SCALE = 0.2   -- cỡ cả bảng so với tile; lệch to/nhỏ thì đổi UI_SCALE trong narrator.py rồi dựng lại
local LIFT = 12     -- độ nổi khỏi mặt tile (đơn vị UI)
local ROWS = 4
local camp, scen, grp, page = 1, 1, 1, 1
local C = {bg = "#15110EF2", head = "#0B0A09", tab = "#2B2521", tabOn = "#8C5C18", clip = "#4A1B16",
           stop = "#6E150F", text = "#EEE4D1"}

local function esc(s)
  return (tostring(s):gsub("&", "&"):gsub("<", "<"):gsub(">", ">"):gsub('"', """))
end

local function btn(id, label, fn, color, size, extra)
  return string.format('<Button id="%s" onClick="%s" color="%s" textColor="%s" fontSize="%d" fontStyle="Bold" %s>%s</Button>',
    id, fn, color, C.text, size, extra or "", esc(label))
end

function onLoad(saved)
  if saved and saved ~= "" then
    local s = JSON.decode(saved)
    camp, scen = s.c or 1, s.s or 1
  end
  if not DATA[camp] then camp = 1 end
  if not DATA[camp].scenarios[scen] then scen = 1 end
  render()
end

function onSave() return JSON.encode({c = camp, s = scen}) end

function render()
  local c = DATA[camp]
  local s = c.scenarios[scen]
  if grp > #s.groups then grp = 1 end
  local g = s.groups[grp]
  local per = g.cols * ROWS
  local pages = math.max(1, math.ceil(#g.clips / per))
  if page > pages then page = pages end
  local cellW = math.floor((940 - (g.cols - 1) * 12) / g.cols)
  local x = {}
  local function add(s) x[#x + 1] = s end
  add(string.format('<Panel position="0 0 -%s" rotation="0 0 180" width="1000" height="760" scale="%s %s 1" color="%s" padding="30 30 26 26">',
    LIFT, SCALE, SCALE, C.bg))
  add('<VerticalLayout spacing="14" childForceExpandHeight="false" childAlignment="UpperCenter">')
  -- campaign
  add('<HorizontalLayout preferredHeight="64" spacing="12" childForceExpandWidth="false">')
  add(btn("cp", "<", "prevCampaign", C.tab, 34, 'preferredWidth="80"'))
  add(string.format('<Text preferredWidth="756" fontSize="34" fontStyle="Bold" color="%s" alignment="MiddleCenter">%s</Text>',
    C.text, esc(c.name)))
  add(btn("cn", ">", "nextCampaign", C.tab, 34, 'preferredWidth="80"'))
  add('</HorizontalLayout>')
  -- chặng
  local opts = {}
  for i, sc in ipairs(c.scenarios) do
    opts[#opts + 1] = string.format('<Option%s>%s</Option>', i == scen and ' selected="true"' or '', esc(sc.name))
  end
  add('<Dropdown id="sd" preferredHeight="64" fontSize="30" onValueChanged="pickScenario">' .. table.concat(opts) .. '</Dropdown>')
  -- nhóm
  add('<HorizontalLayout preferredHeight="60" spacing="10" childForceExpandWidth="true">')
  for i, gr in ipairs(s.groups) do
    add(btn("t" .. i, gr.name, "pickGroup", i == grp and C.tabOn or C.tab, 28))
  end
  add('</HorizontalLayout>')
  -- nút
  add(string.format('<GridLayout preferredHeight="%d" cellSize="%d 62" spacing="12 12" constraint="FixedColumnCount" constraintCount="%d" childAlignment="UpperLeft">',
    ROWS * 74, cellW, g.cols))
  local first = (page - 1) * per
  for k = 1, math.min(per, #g.clips - first) do
    local i = first + k
    add(btn("c" .. i, g.clips[i].label, "playClip", C.clip, g.cols >= 4 and 28 or 26))
  end
  add('</GridLayout>')
  -- trang + dừng
  add('<HorizontalLayout preferredHeight="60" spacing="12" childForceExpandWidth="false">')
  if pages > 1 then
    add(btn("pp", "<", "prevPage", C.tab, 30, 'preferredWidth="80"'))
    add(string.format('<Text preferredWidth="140" fontSize="28" color="%s" alignment="MiddleCenter">%d / %d</Text>', C.text, page, pages))
    add(btn("pn", ">", "nextPage", C.tab, 30, 'preferredWidth="80"'))
    add('<Text preferredWidth="380"></Text>')
  else
    add('<Text preferredWidth="716"></Text>')
  end
  add(btn("st", "Dừng", "stopAudio", C.stop, 30, 'preferredWidth="220"'))
  add('</HorizontalLayout>')
  add('</VerticalLayout></Panel>')
  self.UI.setXml(table.concat(x))
end

function playClip(player, value, id)
  local clip = DATA[camp].scenarios[scen].groups[grp].clips[tonumber(id:sub(2))]
  MusicPlayer.setCurrentAudioclip({url = clip.url, title = clip.title})
  broadcastToAll("▶ " .. clip.title, {0.85, 0.8, 0.7})
  Wait.condition(function() MusicPlayer.play() end, function() return MusicPlayer.loaded end, 30,
    function() broadcastToAll("Audio chưa tải xong: " .. clip.title, {1, 0.5, 0.4}) end)
end

function pickScenario(player, value, id)
  for i, sc in ipairs(DATA[camp].scenarios) do
    if sc.name == value and i ~= scen then
      scen, grp, page = i, 1, 1
      render()
      return
    end
  end
end

function pickGroup(player, value, id) grp, page = tonumber(id:sub(2)), 1; render() end
function stopAudio() MusicPlayer.pause() end
function prevPage() page = math.max(1, page - 1); render() end
function nextPage() page = page + 1; render() end
function prevCampaign() camp = camp > 1 and camp - 1 or #DATA; scen, grp, page = 1, 1, 1; render() end
function nextCampaign() camp = camp < #DATA and camp + 1 or 1; scen, grp, page = 1, 1, 1; render() end
